description_en: Uses facial recognition technology to compare and verify two input face images, returning the face comparison result and similarity score
description_zh: 通过人脸识别技术，可以对传入的两张人脸图片进行比对验证，返回人脸对比结果和相似度分值
kebab_example: aliyun cloudauth-intl face-compare --merchant-biz-id e0c34a77f5ac40a5aa5e6ed20c353888 --source-face-picture base64 --source-face-picture-url https://000face1.jpeg --target-face-picture base64 --target-face-picture-url https://000face2.jpeg --face-picture-quality-check N --face-quality-check Y --region cn-hangzhou
name: FaceCompare

parameters.help_en: A unique business identifier customized by the merchant, used for subsequent troubleshooting. Supports a combination of letters and numbers with a maximum length of 32 characters. Ensure it is unique
parameters.help_zh: 商户侧自定义的业务唯一标识，用于后续定位排查问题使用。支持字母和数字的组合，长度最长32位，请确保唯一
parameters.name: merchant_biz_id

parameters.help_en:
Base64-encoded face photo.

Note
If you choose this method to pass in the photo, check the photo size and do not pass in an oversized photo.
Either SourceFacePicture or SourceFacePictureUrl must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
人像照片Base64编码。

说明
如果您选择该方式传入证件图片，请检查照片大小，不要传入过大的照片。
SourceFacePicture与SourceFacePictureUrl二选一
parameters.name: source_face_picture

parameters.help_en: The HTTPS or HTTP URL of the face image
parameters.name: source_face_picture_url

parameters.help_en:

TargetFacePicture与TargetFacePictureUrl二选一
